topic: JavaScript DOM, Events, Forms, and Validation
learningObjectives: Manipulate DOM elements dynamically using JavaScript.
Handle user interactions through browser events.
Validate form inputs and provide appropriate feedback.

activities.title: DOM Tree Explorer
activities.instruction: Click elements to reveal their DOM relationships.

content.concept: The DOM represents an HTML document as a hierarchical tree of elements and nodes.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

activities.title: Event Flow Builder
activities.instruction: Arrange the steps of a browser event.

content.concept: Browser events connect user actions such as clicks and input changes to JavaScript handlers.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

activities.title: Form Validation Lab
activities.instruction: Select the correct validation rule for each field.

content.concept: Client-side validation checks user input before data is submitted to the server.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

activities.title: Interactive Form Builder
activities.instruction: Build a form using fields, events, and validation.

content.concept: Interactive forms combine HTML inputs, DOM updates, event handlers, and validation logic.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.
